# criblio_pack_collector (Resource)

Manages a Collector within a Pack using the same input_collector_* configuration as criblio_collector.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The pack must already exist in this worker group. Its ID can also be supplied
# by a criblio_pack resource, for example: pack = criblio_pack.my_pack.id.
resource "criblio_pack_collector" "rest" {
  group_id = "default"
  pack     = "my-pack"
  id       = "rest-api"

  input_collector_rest = {
    collector = {
      type = "rest"
      conf = {
        collect_url    = "'https://api.example.com/events'"
        collect_method = "get"
        authentication = "none"
      }
    }
    input = {
      type           = "collection"
      send_to_routes = true
    }
    ttl = "4h"
  }
}

resource "criblio_pack_collector" "lake" {
  group_id = "default"
  pack     = "my-pack"
  id       = "lake-events"

  input_collector_cribl_lake = {
    collector = {
      type = "cribl_lake"
      conf = {
        dataset = "my-dataset"
      }
    }
    input = {
      type           = "collection"
      send_to_routes = true
    }
    ttl = "4h"
  }
}
```

- `max_task_size` (String) Limits the bundle size for files above the lower task bundle size. For example, if your upper bundle size is 10MB, you can bundle up to five 2MB files into one task. Files greater than this size will be assigned to individual tasks.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = criblio_pack_collector.my_criblio_pack_collector
  id = jsonencode({
    group_id = "default"
    id = "example"
    pack = "example"
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import criblio_pack_collector.my_criblio_pack_collector '{"group_id": "default", "id": "example", "pack": "example"}'
```
